theme: Lý do nghỉ việc & chuyển việc

vocab.example: I gave notice two weeks before my last working day.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã báo nghỉ việc hai tuần trước ngày làm việc cuối cùng.

vocab.example: This role is a new opportunity for me to grow my skills.
vocab.example_vi: Vị trí này là một cơ hội mới để tôi phát triển kỹ năng.

vocab.example: The company restructuring reduced our team from ten to five people.
vocab.example_vi: Việc tái cơ cấu công ty đã giảm đội nhóm từ mười xuống còn năm người.

vocab.example: I left because of a lack of growth in my previous role.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi nghỉ việc vì thiếu cơ hội phát triển trong vai trò trước đây.

vocab.meaning_vi: nghỉ việc một cách khéo léo, đúng mực
vocab.example: It's important to resign gracefully and help with the transition.
vocab.example_vi: Điều quan trọng là nghỉ việc một cách khéo léo và hỗ trợ bàn giao.

vocab.example: She made an industry switch from banking to technology.
vocab.example_vi: Cô ấy đã chuyển ngành từ ngân hàng sang công nghệ.

vocab.example: During my exit interview, I shared honest feedback about the team.
vocab.example_vi: Trong buổi phỏng vấn thôi việc, tôi đã chia sẻ phản hồi thật lòng về đội nhóm.

vocab.meaning_vi: làm mất lòng, cắt đứt quan hệ
vocab.example: I always try not to burn bridges when I leave a job.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi luôn cố gắng không làm mất lòng ai khi nghỉ việc.

listening.title: Phỏng vấn: Lý do nghỉ việc và chuyển việc

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: Thanks for coming in today, Duc. Why are you looking to leave your current company?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I gave notice last month because I want a new opportunity to grow.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: I see. Was there a specific reason, like company restructuring?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Actually, yes. There was some restructuring, and my team lost several projects.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: That makes sense. Did you also feel a lack of growth in your role?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, I'd been in the same position for three years without a promotion.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: Understood. Are you looking to make an industry switch as well?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: No, I still want to stay in software, just at a bigger company.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: Good to know. How did your manager react when you resigned?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I tried to resign gracefully and even offered to help during the handover.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: That's great. Did you have an exit interview with HR?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, and I made sure not to burn bridges with anyone there.

questions.q: Why did Duc give notice at his current company?
options: He wants a new opportunity to grow

questions.q: What happened at Duc's company that affected his team?
What did Duc do to avoid burning bridges?
options: He resigned gracefully and helped with handover

shadowing: I gave notice because I wanted a new growth opportunity.
